steps.en: Install the Desktop app from the latest release (macOS or Windows)
steps.zh: 从最新 Release 安装桌面应用（macOS 或 Windows）

steps.en: Starts the local Runtime and prepares a default project
steps.zh: 拉起本机 Runtime，并准备好一个默认项目

steps.en: Complete a valid Codex login — required for real model tasks
steps.zh: 完成有效的 Codex 登录——真实模型任务必须有

steps.en: Open Video Translation (or type the job in the composer) and give it a video
steps.zh: 打开视频翻译（或在对话框里下任务），丢进一条视频

steps.en: Transcribes, segments, translates, optionally dubs, and exports SRT, audio, or video
steps.zh: 转录、断句、翻译，可选配音，导出 SRT、音频或视频

steps.en: Keeps the conversation and visual workspace on the same versioned task
steps.zh: 让对话和可视化工作区盯着同一条带版本的任务

value.en: Subtitled, dubbed, or generated media in one local project, without bouncing between a coding-agent terminal and a pile of SaaS tabs
value.zh: 字幕、配音或生成的媒体都落在同一个本机项目里，不用在 coding-agent 终端和一堆 SaaS 标签之间来回跳

sources: README.md Quick Start / Install the Desktop App: download from https://github.com/krillinai/OpenCreator/releases/latest (macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, or Windows x64); Desktop includes Codex CLI; real model tasks require a valid Codex login; first launch starts the local Runtime and prepares a default project
README.md Quick Start / Run Web from Source: `pnpm web:dev`, open http://127.0.0.1:19861/
README.md Creator Tools / Video Translation: import local or public videos; transcribe; LLM segmentation/alignment/translation; bilingual subtitles, dubbing; export SRT, audio, or video

README.md OpenCreator System Architecture: workspace and Agent conversation are synchronized projections of one workflow state; revisions create new versions; daemon owns process lifecycle; Codex remains the execution source of truth
README.md Related Projects: Codex, yt-dlp, FFmpeg, Whisper family, Fastify, Electron, SQLite
